page.overview:
What is Five Nights at Freddy's 2?

, commonly abbreviated as FNaF2, is an independent point-and-click sit-and-survive horror game developed and published by Scottgames, LLC, which released on November 10, 2014, for Windows, as the second installment in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. Shortly after, the game was ported to Amazon Fire OS on November 13, 2014, released on Desura on November 14, 2014, ported to Android on November 15, 2014, iOS on November 20, 2014, and Windows Phone on December 2, 2014.

Scottgames would partner with Clickteam LLC in 2018 to deliver HD, improved "remastered" ports to mobile and consoles. The mobile updates would release on October 29, 2019, for Android and iOS. The Xbox port would release on November 28, 2019, and on the PlayStation and Nintendo Switch on November 29, 2019. These ports/updates would fix bugs, remove copyrighted material, and add a subtitles and cheats menu.

A film adaptation was released on December 5, 2025.

Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!
